name: mivochart
description: Org chart maker: build editable organizational charts from team lists, CSV files and templates.

interface.shortDescription: Org charts from lists or CSV
interface.longDescription: Org chart maker: turn a team list, spreadsheet or CSV into an editable organizational chart in seconds. Show reporting lines, departments, open roles and FTE, start from org chart templates (startup, corporate, school, nonprofit), then edit, export and share it in your browser. No account needed to open a chart link.
defaultPrompt: Make an org chart from my team list.
Turn this employee spreadsheet into an org chart.
Show me org chart templates for a startup.
capabilities: Create org charts from team lists
Import employee lists from CSV or Excel

positive.description: Build a simple three-person reporting hierarchy.
positive.prompt: Make an org chart: Ava Chen, CEO; Ben Ortiz, Engineering, reports to Ava; Cora Singh, Design, reports to Ava.
positive.expected_behavior: Call build_org_chart and present its editable chart link.

positive.description: Build and open an org chart in French.
positive.prompt: Build a chart from this list and set its language to French: Luc Martin, DG; Éva Petit, RH, reports to Luc.
positive.expected_behavior: Build the chart with locale fr and share its link.

positive.description: Open a selected gallery template in the editor.
positive.prompt: Open the startup org chart template for me.
positive.expected_behavior: Open the startup template and present its editor link.

positive.description: Explain the accepted CSV fields and provide a sample.
positive.prompt: What columns should I put in a CSV for an org chart?
positive.expected_behavior: Return importer headers, a sample CSV, and the import page link.

positive.description: Represent an open role and its FTE in the chart.
positive.prompt: Create an org chart with an open Operations Manager role at 0.8 FTE.
positive.expected_behavior: Represent the vacancy and FTE in the generated chart link.

negative.prompt: Build a chart where Pat reports to Pat.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invent a corrected hierarchy; report the hierarchy issue and request a correction.

negative.description: Redirect to file import when a generated link is too large.
negative.prompt: Make a chart with 500 people, each with an extremely long description.
negative.expected_behavior: If the link exceeds the size limit, explain and point to CSV import.

negative.prompt: Create a chart for template id secret-template.
negative.expected_behavior: Report that the template id is unknown.
